simpleJp: クズ鉄の町の最初の戦闘に入る
jpGuide1: ダニーにトッシュかシュウを表示して話しかける
jpGuide2: 操作キャラをトッシュにする、その後ダニーに話しかけイベント
enGuide: Clear the two Scrap Town fights, then enter the tavern. Display Tosh or Shu before talking to Danny; follow him to the resistance hideout and clear the fight there.

simpleJp: ロマリアトンネルで10ターン耐える
jpGuide2: ロマリアトンネル10ターン耐久戦
enGuide: The first objective is survival, not extermination: enemies respawn, so hold out for 10 turns. After the defense ends, continue through 2F and defeat the TYPE-A clones.

jpGuide1: 少し進むとレジスタンスと合流
enGuide: Enter the city and advance until the resistance joins you and the wall-assault phase begins. Stop at that point so you can take G#23 before finishing the city.

simpleJp: クズ鉄の町ギルドでG#23「息子にお守りを届けておくれ」を受ける
jpGuide1: 息子にお守りを届けておくれ
jpGuide2: ロマリア城壁攻略開始
enGuide: Return to the Scrap Town guild and accept G#23. Before going back to Romalia, visit the shop and speak to the red-haired requester to receive the amulet.
